LaCrosse seeds is our source for forage and turf seeds. They also provide cover crop seeds, small grain seed, food plot seed, and erosion control products like straw erosion mats.
Hohl's Farm Supply, Inc. has been part of the agricultural environment almost 50 years. With our experience, we can help you get a better understanding of your area's soil, weather conditions, crops, food plot, and animal feed needs.
We at Hohl’s Farm Supply realize not everyone has a farm. That is why we carry a large line of Grass seed & Lawn care products, pet food and wild bird seed.
Our goal is to supply our customers’ with the best of Quality and Customer Service!
